# utopia-php/cache

> 标签: cache, framework, php, upf, utopia

## 简介

A simple cache library to manage application cache storing, loading and purging

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。

- 官网：https://packagist.org/packages/utopia-php%2Fcache
